title: Rare heap-use-after-free when clearing dependencies between scripts during exit
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.dev.custom_build [2af785641]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (2af785641) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 14 Mar 2026 01:07:43 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

Seems like sometimes when the base reference clears in the script it can be the last reference to that script and at the same time the next script in `script_list`, so it first gets it, and then frees it in the `Ref` destructor.

Also I know that circular references are bad, but I can't actually reproduce it in a simple project without it, and I have the same error in a more complex project, and in that project I don't think I have circular references... But maybe I have them, idk

Build with 
```
scons use_llvm=yes linker=lld accesskit=no lto=none debug_symbols=yes tests=yes production=yes use_tsan=yes extra_suffix=base
```
Start command
```
TSAN_OPTIONS="suppressions=./misc/error_suppressions/tsan.txt" ./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.llvm.base.san --path /home/noctemcat/projects/Godot/heap-after-free/ --gpu-index 0 --rendering-driver opengl3 -e
```
I can't actually test it with asan, but thankfully I can barely launch tsan, which I blame nvidia for

Also to be honest, I'm not sure how rare it is, I just know that it doesn't happen in all projects, just in some of them

### Steps to reproduce

Open the project with sanitizer build, close it
